message_batch_id.description: ID of the Message Batch to cancel. Example: "msgbatch_013Zva2CMHLNnXjNJJKqJ2EF"

actions.description: Count tokens for an Anthropic message request.
actions.name: count-message-tokens

model.description: The model that will count tokens. Example: "claude-sonnet-4-0"

messages.description: Input messages to count tokens for.

input_tokens.description: The total number of tokens across the provided list of messages, system prompt, and tools.

actions.description: Create a message batch in Anthropic.
actions.name: create-message-batch

custom_id.description: Unique identifier for the request within the batch. Must be unique. Example: "my-request-1"

params.description: Messages API creation parameters for the individual request. See https://docs.anthropic.com/en/api/messages

requests.description: List of requests for prompt completion. Each is an individual request to create a Message.

name.description: Tool name when type is "tool". Example: "my_tool"

actions.description: Delete or archive a file in Anthropic.
actions.name: delete-file

file_id.description: ID of the File to delete. Example: "file_011CNha8iCJcU1wXNR6q4V8w"

actions.description: Retrieve a single file from Anthropic.
actions.name: get-file

file_id.description: The ID of the file to retrieve. Example: "file_01HqW8Kq0Z2Q2W8Kq0Z2Q2W8"

actions.description: Retrieve a single message batch from Anthropic.
actions.name: get-message-batch

message_batch_id.description: The ID of the message batch to retrieve. Example: "msgbatch_01Ab2cDe3Fg4hIj5Kl6mNo7Pq8r"

actions.description: Retrieve a single model from Anthropic.
actions.name: get-model

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: Number of items to return per page. Defaults to 20. Ranges from 1 to 1000.

scope_id.description: Filter by scope ID. Only returns files associated with the specified scope (e.g., a session ID).

actions.description: Stream or retrieve results for an Anthropic Message Batch
actions.name: list-message-batch-results

message_batch_id.description: The ID of the Message Batch to retrieve results for. Example: "msgbatch_01AbCdEfGhIjKlMnOpQrStUv"

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

before_id.description: ID of the object to use as a cursor for pagination. Returns the page immediately before this object.

limit.description: Number of items to return per page. Defaults to 20. Ranges from 1 to 1000.
